decisions.reason: As a 2023 launch close to the core range and still marketed on its own page in 2024, it likely meets at least minimum aspirations and can be retained within the firm's product and service slack.

This articulated dumper extends the established construction offer, and continued standalone presentation suggests acceptable performance relative to aspiration levels, so management would keep it while monitoring results.

Because this more distant mine rescue vehicle lost prominence from its own page to only a mention in 2024, management would read this as likely falling short of aspirations and reallocate resources toward stronger core or development projects.

A multi-model telescopic loader line within the established business fits the firm's capabilities well, and continued full website presence indicates enough traction to justify keeping it on the market.
The reported large order and statement that it is the most popular rental material lift indicate performance above aspiration, making withdrawal very unlikely.
Although more distant from the established offer, the quantified field result after seven months is strong enough to support continued learning and commercialization rather than an early withdrawal.
